title: 第960章 一座孤城万仞山第959章 你总得有这个本事
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
大江远上层云间。
一座孤城万仞山。
登封城，不过一王座麾下仙王所统领城池，其存在特点便是在西方天地这辽阔平原之上显得鹤立鸡群，毕竟这里太过于平坦，一座城头只会让人觉得特殊。
而原本在登封城后，是并无雄关大山阻拦，西方天地乃直通两界交界所在，就算早年有一次黑暗动乱也就彻底荡平了，可如今是被层层布置。
的确是一座孤城，身后也的确是万仞雄峰，此地如今被公孙起所领玄甲军所镇守，其实也就摆明了，不破此城，古界大军便不可前行一步。
长生大帝凌霄率先入阵，一招帝术先落登封城前，先碾一遍，以防大乾王朝在此地设置有阵法、陷阱等威胁，紧随其后，那黑云压境而至，放眼望去，望不到尽头！
西方天地由长生大帝领衔，幽夜王城众准帝仙王修士，黑暗帝宫诸准帝修士及其麾下无数供奉，仙王，不过是这茫茫大军之中最不起眼的，寻常仙王甚至连来此的资格都没有，只配给上层修士贡献修为！
这还仅仅是表面的，最初的计划，可如今只会更强，除却这一批明面上的，还有潜伏着的，隐匿着的，那是一支独属于鹤无双的太子禁卫，这批修士的实力能够保证数位王座联手围攻鹤无双，能拿命给他争取一个呼唤黑暗古皇的机会，实力便不言而喻，可他们不露面。
一来是作为后手隐藏，不便于暴露。
二来西方天地之战涉及虽然重大，他亲征此地督战，却也闲庭信步，身旁夜王等五位王座都在身前，并无必要。
“帝子其实可以不来，凌霄既放出话来，想来也会遵守。”
鹤无双望着眼前打头阵的凌霄的背影，眼神中带着凝重与审视，却在听到这话之后笑着摇头：“当然不是。”
他笑着道：“楚宁这些人来古界，究竟是做什么的还不清楚，诸位觉得他们要死守西方天地，这有道理，长生大帝觉得他们可能会放弃西方天地以进攻其他天地，当然也有道理，我不过是来看看此地情况。”
“若此方天地真的被其他天命准帝死守，我也当参战一同扫平心腹大患，岂有坐镇后方之理，若其他天命准帝去往其他战线，诸位自当按原本安排前往，迅速支援。”
裘天道听完这话，其实觉得很有道理，毕竟作为面对过楚宁知道这小子有多阴的，但想来，凌霄提出的第二种路子就是他们能做的极限了，而且一旦暴露，这些人会立刻转头就跑，放弃这所谓大义！
毕竟，谁会为了一帮已经死的人而冒这么大的风险，而且还是必死，真如果说要接替始皇帝的位置镇压古界，楚宁......还是个笑话。
明王笑着询问：“那倘若他们既不死守这方天地，又不支援其他战线，当为何解？”
鹤无双反而轻松：“那就证明我太高看他了？可既然来了，无论如何都会露个面吧，不然岂不是让那位始皇帝太寒心？”
这边笑着，前面的凌霄俨然已开始准备出手，按照他们的说法，长生大帝既直接立军令状可扫平西方天地，那他们，也不着急动手，你不是自己有足够实力？
而凌霄显然也不曾在意此事，仅一步踏前便欲直破此城，可也不出意料，被一道身影当场拦路。

出手者，以裹挟极致杀意的一剑，逼得凌霄不得不退上半步，而那魁梧男子出面之后便是面露讥讽，道了句果真小人！
“陛下对你还算欣赏，以自身之意推出那等光阴道法，可没想到，为苟全性命，终成了自己守护之人的大敌，可耻，可悲！”
他手持一把无形剑器，周身裹黑铠，就是方才与楚宁对话的，这支玄甲军最大的领袖公孙起，位列始皇座下第一杀将！
凌霄面无表情，回答着公孙起的讥讽：“生前我为天地，死后天地自当为我，立场不同，谈何对错？”
二人皆不曾轻举妄动，皆是在观察对方弱点，仅仅片刻之间，凌霄便洞悉而出面前这位让古界吃了不少大亏的第一杀将。
他不是人，不是活人，更不是如始皇帝那般的“死物”，他的存在仿佛更像是某种意志的融合，规则生灵，非要去说，像是饕餮、穷奇、混沌、梼杌这一类，论意，梼杌掌战意受限，可公孙起掌杀意，加持人皇宝术，恐怕无限.....
不死不灭的生灵，除非剥夺其规则，否则难以斩灭，而那城内玄甲军，皆是这样的存在！
这与深渊恶鬼又有何异，一群不怕死的死灵军团，又能怎么去打？
然而凌霄的眼界实在太高，几乎是很快笑了出来。
掌控杀意的死灵、意志么，他正巧有所研究，甚至他无需靠什么东西去做解决这个麻烦，只管靠自己。
凌霄手中掐出帝诀，一丝极为渺小的生命之意出现在其指尖，就仿佛是一座天地诞生之初的最初生灵之气，然而，这生命之意以极快的速度进行膨胀，从他的脚下，再到延绵到脚下天地，凡天地有生意者皆为其界，而当这生意以不可阻挡的气势充斥了整个天地的时候，这座破败的天地变得苍翠欲滴。
可凌霄做这一切，显然不是为了让战场之上变得更赏心悦目一些，既然这批大乾王朝派来镇守的军队，是死灵的概念产物，那他便让这些人全部活过来。
生命的本质是毁灭，也是创造，生与死的更替带来了生生不息的延绵，既然他们没有囚笼，凌霄便为他们打造一座！
一刹那，天地之间生命之意无穷迸发具现，疯狂朝着这些死灵的体内涌去，筋骨重塑、血肉重组，他们不再是虚假的外壳，而是变成了活生生的生灵，变成了完全由他们自己所掌控的活生生的人！
如此变化，如此感觉，是这些人多少年不曾感受到的，他们活过来的，当真是活过来了？
这让人振奋，激动，震颤，可紧随其后他们便察觉到了什么。
当他们有了生命，就会拥有生命的本能，开始对死亡恐惧，对痛苦逃避，对许许多多他们忘却了的东西重新拥有那种感知......
这不该是一支求死的军队所拥有的，可他们太陌生了，他们根本就不知道那是一种什么感觉了，甚至不知道该如何压制！
content_en:
The clouds are far above the river.
An isolated city in Wanren Mountain.
Dengfeng City is just a city under the command of the Immortal King under the Throne. Its existence is characterized by standing out on the vast plains of the Western World. After all, it is too flat here, and a city head will only make people feel special.
Originally, after the city was sealed, there were no mountains to block it, and the western world was directly connected to the junction of the two realms. Even if there was a dark turmoil in the early years, it was completely eliminated, but now it is arranged layer by layer.
It is indeed an isolated city, and behind it is indeed the Ten Thousand Ren Xiong Peak. This place is now guarded by the Xuanjia Army led by Gongsun Qi. In fact, it is clear that the ancient army cannot move forward without breaking this city.
The Immortal Emperor Ling Xiao was the first to enter the battle. He used his imperial skills to land on the city and crush it first to prevent the Daqian Dynasty from setting up formations, traps and other threats here. Following closely behind, the black clouds came over the area. As far as the eye could see, there was no end in sight!
The Western World is led by the Changsheng Emperor, the quasi-emperor immortal king monks in Youye King City, the quasi-emperor immortal monks in the Dark Imperial Palace and their countless followers. The immortal king is just the most inconspicuous among this vast army. The ordinary immortal kings are not even qualified to come here, and are only allocated to the upper-level monks to contribute their cultivation!
This is just the surface, the initial plan, but now it will only become stronger. In addition to this group of apparent ones, there are also lurking and hidden ones. They are a group of prince guards that belong exclusively to He Wushuang. The strength of this group of monks can ensure that the Digital Thrones join forces to besiege He Wushuang. If they can give him a life to fight for a chance to call the Dark Ancient Emperor, their strength is self-evident, but they do not show up.
First, it is hidden as a backhand, making it difficult to expose.
Secondly, although the battle between heaven and earth in the west was very important, he personally went to this place to supervise the battle, but he still strolled around leisurely, with the Night King and other five thrones in front of him, so it was not necessary.
"The emperor actually doesn't have to come. Since Ling Xiao has made a promise, he will abide by it if he thinks about it."
He Wushuang looked at the back of Ling Xiao, who was leading the charge, with solemnity and scrutiny in his eyes, but after hearing this, he smiled and shook his head: "Of course not."
He smiled and said: "It's not clear what people like Chu Ning came to the ancient world for. You think they want to defend the western world, which makes sense. Emperor Changsheng thinks they might give up the western world to attack other worlds. Of course, it also makes sense. I just came to see the situation here."
"If this world is really defended by other Heavenly Mandate Quasi-Emperors, I will also join the battle to eliminate the serious troubles in my heart. There is no reason to sit in the rear. If other Heavenly Mandate Quasi-Emperors go to other fronts, you should go according to the original arrangement and quickly provide support."
After hearing this, Qiu Tiandao actually felt that it made sense. After all, as someone who had faced Chu Ning, he knew how sinister this kid was. But thinking about it, the second method proposed by Ling Xiao was the limit of what they could do, and once exposed, these people would immediately turn around and run away, giving up on this so-called righteousness!
After all, who would take such a big risk for a group of people who are already dead, and they will still die. If they really want to take over the position of the First Emperor and suppress the ancient world, Chu Ning... is still a joke.
King Ming asked with a smile: "Then if they neither defend this area nor support other fronts, what should be the explanation?"
He Wushuang was relaxed: "Does that prove that I think too highly of him? But since he is here, he will show up no matter what. Otherwise, wouldn't it make the First Emperor too chilling?"
They were smiling, and Ling Xiao in front seemed to be preparing to take action. According to them, since Emperor Changsheng could directly issue a military order to wipe out the Western world, they were not in a hurry to take action. Don't you have enough strength?
Ling Xiao obviously didn't care about this matter. He just took one step forward and wanted to break through the city, but as expected, he was blocked by a figure on the spot.
The one who took action used a sword with extreme killing intent, forcing Ling Xiao to take half a step back, and the burly man showed his face after he came forward.He sarcastically said, "You really are a villain!"
"Your Majesty quite appreciates you, and you used your own will to introduce the light vaginal method, but you never expected that in order to save your life, you will eventually become the enemy of the person you are protecting. It is shameful and sad!"
He was holding an invisible sword and was wrapped in black armor. He was the one who had just spoken to Chu Ning. Gongsun Qi, the largest leader of the Black Armor Army, was the number one killer under the First Emperor!
Ling Xiao's face was expressionless as he replied to Gongsun Qi's sarcasm: "I was the heaven and earth during my lifetime, and the heaven and earth will be me after my death. Our positions are different, so what's right or wrong?"
Neither of them acted rashly, they were both observing each other's weaknesses. In just a moment, Ling Xiao had insight into the number one killer in front of him who had caused many heavy losses to the ancient world.
He is not a human being, not a living person, nor is he a "dead thing" like the First Emperor. His existence seems more like the fusion of some kind of will, regulating living beings. It has to be said that Taotie, Qiongqi, Chaos, and Taotie are like Taotie, Qiongqi, Chaos, and Taotie. In terms of intention, Taotie's fighting intention is limited, but Gongsun's palm with killing intention and the blessing of the Human Emperor's treasure are probably unlimited...
Immortal creatures are difficult to kill unless their rules are deprived of them, and the Xuanjia Army in the city are all like this!
How is this different from the evil ghosts of the abyss? How can we fight against a group of undead legions that are not afraid of death?
However, Ling Xiao's vision was so high that he almost laughed out loud.
He happened to be researching the undead spirit and will that controlled the killing intent. He didn't even need to rely on anything to solve this problem, he just had to rely on himself.
Ling Xiao pinched out the Emperor's Secret in his hand, and an extremely small trace of the meaning of life appeared on his fingertips, as if it was the first life energy at the birth of a world. However, this meaning of life expanded at an extremely fast speed, from under his feet to the world under his feet. Anyone who had business in the world was bounded by it. When this business filled the entire world with unstoppable momentum, this ruined world became verdant.
But Ling Xiao obviously didn't do all this to make the battlefield more pleasing to the eye. Since these troops sent by the Daqian Dynasty to guard were products of the concept of the undead, he would make them all come alive.
The essence of life is destruction as well as creation. The replacement of life and death brings about the endless extension of life. Since they have no cage, Ling Xiao will build one for them!
In an instant, the endless meaning of life between heaven and earth burst into reality, rushing towards the bodies of these undead souls, reshaping their muscles and bones, and reorganizing their flesh and blood. They were no longer false shells, but became living creatures, and became living people completely controlled by themselves!
Such changes and feelings are something these people have not felt for many years. Are they really alive after they have come back to life?
This was exhilarating, thrilling, and trembling, but immediately after, they noticed something.
When they have life, they will have the instinct of life, start to fear death, avoid pain, and regain the sense of many things they have forgotten...
This shouldn't be owned by an army seeking death, but they are so unfamiliar that they don't even know what it feels like, or even how to suppress it!
